integrity: Proof is self-contained; exact finite checks supplement but do not establish the infinite-time theorem. Global priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic homogeneous two-coordinate consistent linear system; iid entry-weighted updates; fixed \(0<\alpha<1\). For each fixed order \(p>2\) the matrix parameter may depend on that order. Finite-horizon moments are finite; no nontrivial stationary law or heavy-tailed invariant measure is claimed.
title: Near-identity higher-moment instability of doubly stochastic Gauss–Seidel
